description: CWI's catalog answer to a brief. HARD SCHEMA RULE (from the 2026-09-17 roundtable binding correction): the response publishes clearance STATUS ONLY — a green/amber/red enum describing CWI's internal readiness posture. There is NO free-text terms field and NO terms-adjacent fields (no fees, no territory, no term length). Status is NOT a legal clearance determination — never infer or assert rights, splits, or legal clearances.

disclaimer.description: MUST be present: states the clearance status describes CWI's internal readiness posture only and is NOT a legal clearance determination.

label.description: sample = generated over sample seeds; live = generated over live briefs.

clearance_status.description: CWI internal readiness posture ONLY: green = CWI states ready-to-clear internally; amber = default, needs review; red = not available for this brief. NOT a legal clearance determination. Defaults to amber unless Black states otherwise.

matched_on.description: Structured match rationale — which brief axes the track matched on. Rationale only, never terms.

status_note.description: One line on why this status; must not contain terms, fees, splits, or legal assertions.

no_match_note.description: Honest note when no catalog tracks score above threshold.
